summary: NexGen Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing the mailing of a Management Information Circular for its Annual General and Special Meeting scheduled for June 30, 2026. The circular covers routine items: election of directors, appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor, approval of an amended Shareholder Rights Plan, and setting the board size at nine. The board recommends voting in favor. This is a routine meeting notice with no special-situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate action. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16. No deal terms are present.
